phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Habur–Ibrahim Khalil road crossing complex. Passenger closure and Turkish drivers entering Iraq in their own trucks are separate phases; freight swaps continued in the buffer zone. Current phase only: Habur on the Iraq frontier

date_scope_check.qualification_retained: June 4, 2020 was Turkish-side permission for freight drivers. The contemporaneous August 19 report says Iraq had continued to refuse those drivers and describes their actual return in their own trucks that day. The new phase concerns Turkish drivers crossing into Iraq, not a halt to freight, which continued through trailer and driver exchanges. The truck-driver evidence does not establish passenger restoration. Separately, IOM monitoring on 15 September 2020 reported incoming and outgoing passenger operation under restrictions: incoming foreigners needed Interior Ministry permission; outgoing Iraqis needed such permission or Turkish residence, with educational, medical and business exceptions. This is a later partial-access observation, not an exact first reopening or proof of continuity between passenger observations.
